scope: Sequential local Debug filesystem measurements, three samples per case/cache mode, frozen 16384-row eight-file Parquet source. Baseline overlaps compilation; candidate is measured after the main merge and before final E2Es. These are not randomized paired trials.
report_excerpt_scope: Complete input, executable, configuration, environment and collector provenance, all 48 timing, memory and sort profiles; verbose Prometheus snapshots and shard profiles are omitted. Full report hashes are retained.
conclusion: Every exact answer agrees. Uniform reverse traversal replaces exhaustive decoration with a bounded native prefix. Public-ID navigation bounds wide primary ties in either direction. Retaining completed work prevents replay on ordered-budget fallback. Sparse tombstone cardinality is independently verified without materializing partial-term bitmaps.

oracle_derivation.wide_tie_scope: All rows have revision=0; final public _id stays ASC in both revision directions. Common lake3 snapshot prefix cancels within the query.
oracle_derivation.public_file_digest_recipe: SHA256 of concatenated little-endian uint64 length-prefixed UTF-8 source_id, empty partition, file_id.
oracle_derivation.independence: Expected application IDs derive from declared input row ranges and public-ID encoding, independently of either query executor. The benchmark checks the same expected lists.

candidate.git_head_scope: Collector checkout; executable source commit and binary SHA independently identify the measured code.

comparison.environment_scope: same declared platform and collector; sequential runs are observational, not randomized paired trials

replay_regression.scope: Deterministic native tests retain exact total, public-ID ties and top-K window while preventing duplicate fallback decoration.

sparse_tombstone_regression.scope: Backward, forward, repeated and cross-segment probes; exact count; complete monotone enumeration without tombstones; allocation-failure coverage with and without masks. Dense masks and unsupported filters retain ordinary bitmap execution.

bounded_public_navigation_regression.scope: Existing authenticated public file navigation, current row tree and retained index by-ID tree; no new persisted format or artifact family.

final_validation_executable.scope: CLI and final E2E validation executable. The measured candidate is independently pinned above; the intervening source change reuses an existing error in a test-only fake producer.
